question: What is India’s rank on the World Economic Forum’s Global Competitiveness Index of 141 countries for the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**68th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India was ranked at** 68th position** in the World Economic Forum’s Global Competitiveness Index, 2019.
 
• In the overall competitiveness ranking, **Singapore **replaced the US to take the first position. 
 
• In South Asia, India is followed by Sri Lanka (84), Bangladesh (105), Nepal (108), and Pakistan (110). 
 
• Countries like Colombia (57), Azerbaijan (58), South Africa (60), and Turkey (61) surpassed India in this year’s survey.
